text:
Sun of the one who keeps sad watch!
Star of cold radiance,
whose trembling rays shine only
to show the shadows of night!


Oh, how you resemble
the pale memory of past joy,
which makes the soul see nothing
but shadowy solitude!


Reflection of a flame
now hidden or extinguished,
you fill the mind, but do not kindle it;
you live in the soul, but do not animate it.


You reveal, like yourself, the shadows
you enamel and caress;
and only mute pain beholds you,
keeping fervent vigil.

translation.title: To the Moon
